note: SNG-252 §2c (Aevi 2026-08-01): move consequence-hints per function family × encounter kind + per-kind emphasis order. The moves chip reads '{ability} — {FAMILY} · {hint}'; this authors the {hint} in the kind's CURRENCY (hp/ground/resolve/insight/progress across) and VOICE (SNG-247 kind voice). `emphasis` = the family order the kind surfaces first (kind-aware ordering - a standoff leads with INFLUENCE/KNOW, a fight with HARM). CCode reads hint[kind][family]; falls back to `default` for a family with no kind-specific hint. A family a kind can't use meaningfully gets a `weak` note (still offered - moves are shortcuts not a cage - but flagged as off-currency).

families.INFLUENCE: rattles them — may cost them the initiative
families.SHAPE: changes the ground of the fight
families.MOVE: repositions — closes or breaks the distance
families.SUSTAIN: steadies your wind for the next exchange

howCCodeUses: For each owned ability's family in the ribbon moves, look up byKind[encounterKind].families[FAMILY]; if a string, use as the hint; if an object with .weak, render the .text dimmed/flagged (still clickable - moves are shortcuts not a cage, but the player sees it's off-currency for this kind). Order the family groups by byKind[kind].emphasis. Fall back to default[FAMILY] if the kind lacks a specific hint. The chip reads: '{ability.name} — {FAMILY} · {hint}'.
